candidate.title: RedBS-Seq / caMAB-seq
candidate.scope: Assigned middle Illumina row: a 5fc residue icon and reduced-bisulfite description, a DNA cartoon containing C/5mC/5hmC/5fC/5caC, Control and NaBH4 branches, separately repeated bisulfite-treatment/PCR captions, and terminal DNA in the Sequence column. The drawn control/reduction comparison is the RedBS-Seq architecture (redBS-Seq in the primary paper). caMAB-seq remains a distinct grouped target: the cited 2016 implementation requires an explicitly paper-supported M.SssI interface between reduction and bisulfite conversion, represented separately from the drawn unprotected reduced branch. The neighboring oxBS-Seq and fCAB-Seq rows, clipped CAB/EDC/linker/pulldown headings above, and peripheral Biotin structure belong outside this assigned row. This extraction describes the conversion/readout core, not complete library preparation or the unshown reduced-representation adaptation.
